metadata.datasource: Generated with spektrafilm_profile_builder 0.1.0 from digitised data-sheet curves. KODAK motion picture film technical information data sheet TI2082 (1993-10 (Revised 10-93)), 5298-ti2082.pdf, PDF page(s) 7;8;9, EASTMAN EXR 500T Color Negative Film 5298 / 7298: https://125px.com/docs/motionpicture/kodak/5298-ti2082.pdf Estimate placeholders (not on the sheet): curves traced from ~137 dpi chart images (accuracy ~0.5 px of the chart); spectral sensitivity on the sheet's log scale, absolute level from the builder's mid-grey anchoring; sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves; individual CMY dyes reconstructed by the builder from the printed mid-scale neutral and D-min (not printed); dye densities outside the printed wavelength range; print stock: KODAK VISION 2383 (the shipped cine print profile; the contemporary 5386 / 2386 / 2393 era prints are not modelled separately); interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet; runtime default for negatives); hanatos2025 adaptation parameters borrowed from the shipped Kodak negatives (pinned donors). Original data are property of the respective holders.
